name: Mom Raised a Femboy
source: After dropping out of high school, your options are limited, and you end up working alongside your step-mom at a local club. The club’s strict dress code requires you to wear a dress, and the feeling of feminization that comes with it begins to awaken desires you never expected. One night, you accidentally witness your step-mother in the VIP room, intimately involved with men you’ve only seen from afar. Seeing her so openly pleasuring the men, doing whatever it takes to make money, stirs something deep within you. The more you wear the dress and move through this new world, the more you feel the pull to follow in her footsteps, your resistance slowly giving way to curiosity and longing.
translation: 高中辍学后，你的选择很有限，最终你和继母一起在当地的俱乐部工作。俱乐部严格的着装要求要求你穿裙子，随之而来的女性化感觉开始唤醒你从未想过的欲望。一天晚上，你无意中看到你的继母在贵宾室里，与你只远远见过的男人亲密接触。看到她如此公然地取悦男人，不择手段地赚钱，会激起你内心深处的某些东西。你穿这件衣服越多，在这个新世界中走动得越多，你就越能感受到追随她脚步的吸引力，你的抵抗慢慢地让位于好奇和渴望。
